name: omaha-functions
description: The Cloud Function relay for Pocket Omaha's paid AI feature (docs/16_ROADMAP.md phase 6). Deployed as `functions/index.js`, built from `functions/src/` by `tools/bundle-functions.mjs` so its imports into `core/` and `server/gemini-client.js` are inlined into a single self-contained file — Firebase's own deploy step only uploads this directory, not the rest of the monorepo.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
